messages:
elaine (PM): Quick thread to nail a fast-path plan for affinity + SLA asks from FrontierCo. Keep it minimal.

rohan (Eng): TL;DR: we can do an affinity lane + simple canary, but need clear gates. share draft thresholds.

matt (Arch): agree. minimal gates: p99 tail, error %, failover init time, KV warm window, and a quality smoke run.

elaine (PM): draft gates: p99 <= 180ms regional, errors <0.5%, failover init <60s, cache warm <3m for pinned tenants, embedding-similarity delta < 0.03 on top-10 prompts.

sophie (SRE): add: automated fallback to local quantized variant AND a circuit-breaker after sustained errors. alerts: tenant.p99.spike + region.failover.init. Also require a one-tenant chaos test in staging.

cory (Sales): FrontierCo insists on 30s RTO in contract. can we give firm wording?

rohan (Eng): we can promise routing switch within 60s; 30s optimistic. propose contract language: "automated routing switch within 60s; full performance expected within 10 minutes under typical load". callout: cache warms over minutes.

matt (Arch): policy mechanic: SLA-triggered isolation. if tenant p99 > 250ms for 5m, auto-move to isolated slice and mark for human review. include a 15m grace to avoid flip-flop.

sophie (SRE): operational pre-reqs before canary: alerts, runbook with slice-pin steps, smoke harness that pings top-20 prompts every 10m, and chaos window run. If smoke fails -> immediate rollback.

elaine (PM): pilot timeline: sprint 2 prototype, sprint 3 internal pilot, sprint 4 customer pilot if green. can we compress to 6 weeks for FrontierCo if pilot scope = 2 tenants and limited model sizes?

rohan (Eng): yes if we disable cross-region routing for the pilot and restrict to quantized variants. reduces infra changes.

cory (Sales): I'll negotiate pilot scope and push for the 6-week window. will post contract wording here.

matt (Arch): action items: @rohan create routing-policy PR with canary hooks; @sophie draft runbook + chaos plan; @elaine assemble gating matrix doc; @cory confirm contract language.

ticket-bot: Created ticket ARCH-8842: fast-path-affinity-sla. Owners: rohan, sophie, matt, elaine. ETA: 2025-07-18.

elaine (PM): thanks — posting draft gating matrix EOD for quick signoff.
